sentences.text: The petitioner wanted a clarification as to whether the past services in the Government of India would count for pension, gratuity etc., for which there was no response.
Hence, the the petitioner opted for service under Government of India.

In 2013, the petitioner reverted to parent department,
but was declared surplus and was posted to Income Tax Department, where he is working now as Inspector.
The Government of India, during March 2017, issued a Memorandum of Understanding that past services of such absorbed employees to FSSAI will count for pension and gratuity.

Hence,
the petitioner sent a representation on 03.07.2017, requesting to revoke the option exercised by him on 26.03.2012 and seeking absorption into FSSAI in order to avail the benefits extended to the absorbed employees.
3. Mr.Su.Srinivasan, learned Standing Counsel takes notice on behalf of the respondents.

4. In view of the limited nature of the prayer, the respondents are directed to consider the representations of the petitioner dated 03.07.2017, in proper perspective, and pass orders thereon,
within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
The writ petition is disposed of accordingly.
No costs.
